posting_trigger: Approved purchase invoice version becomes POSTING_READY
example_debit_account_categories: Expense or Inventory or Asset; Input VAT Receivable when deductible
example_credit_account_categories: Accounts Payable; rounding gain if approved
amount_basis: Approved net supply and deductible/non-deductible tax policy
subledger_effect: Create AP open item for vendor and due date
tax_provider_effect: Received tax document reconciles to source; provider state does not imply posting

reversal_or_correction_rule: Reverse original journal then post corrected source version; provider cancellation handled separately
accountant_decisions_required: Expense/asset capitalization rules; input VAT deductibility; AP/control/rounding accounts; evidence requirements; accrual date

posting_trigger: Final approved expense claim passes posting policy
example_debit_account_categories: Expense category; Input VAT Receivable if deductible
example_credit_account_categories: Employee Payable or Corporate Card Payable or Cash Clearing
amount_basis: Approved reimbursable amount with policy-approved VAT split
subledger_effect: Create AP/open payable item unless already paid under approved policy
tax_provider_effect: Card/tax provider evidence may enrich reconciliation but cannot create success or journal alone
required_gate_conditions: Authenticated company; claimant and company match; final approval snapshot; READY receipt/evidence; expense policy; active account mapping; open period; no self-approval where prohibited; revision; idempotency

reversal_or_correction_rule: Rejected claim has no posting; correction reverses posted journal and uses a new claim revision

posting_trigger: Confirmed receipt or reconciled bank credit becomes POSTING_READY
example_credit_account_categories: Accounts Receivable; Customer Advance Liability; approved difference account
amount_basis: Confirmed receipt amount and currency; allocated amount cannot exceed available amount
subledger_effect: Allocate receipt to one or more AR open items; residual may remain unapplied
tax_provider_effect: Bank provider event remains pending until verified/reconciled; no live balance or receipt false-success
required_gate_conditions: Authenticated company; FINANCE_ACCESS; verified payment source; bank/cash account; open period; customer/currency validation; allocation residual check; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Receipt ID/version; provider/reconciliation reference; posting request; journal; allocation IDs; customer/project source refs
reversal_or_correction_rule: Unallocation is audited; accounting correction reverses receipt journal and posts replacement under policy
accountant_decisions_required: Cash/bank/clearing accounts; customer advance treatment; bank fee and FX difference policy; allocation date; unapplied receipt policy

posting_trigger: Approved payment execution or reconciled bank debit becomes POSTING_READY
example_debit_account_categories: Accounts Payable; Supplier Advance Asset; approved fee account
amount_basis: Confirmed paid amount and currency; allocation cannot exceed payment or AP residual
subledger_effect: Allocate payment to one or more AP open items; residual may remain unapplied
tax_provider_effect: Bank provider acknowledgement is not posting until verified and reconciled
required_gate_conditions: Authenticated company; FINANCE_ACCESS; payment approval; verified execution evidence; open period; supplier/currency validation; allocation residual check; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Payment ID/version; approval snapshot; provider/reconciliation ref; posting request; journal; allocation IDs; project source refs
reversal_or_correction_rule: Cancellation and bank return are separate events; reverse and repost rather than edit posted journal
accountant_decisions_required: Bank/clearing/advance accounts; fee/FX treatment; allocation and payment date; approval threshold; returned-payment policy

posting_trigger: Provider issue/receipt event is reconciled to its approved source document
example_debit_account_categories: No new debit when source invoice already posted; Accounts Receivable only when an approved tax-document-as-source policy applies
example_credit_account_categories: No new credit when source invoice already posted; Revenue and Output VAT only when approved tax-document-as-source policy applies
amount_basis: Provider-confirmed supply and tax amounts must reconcile to source; never post twice
subledger_effect: No independent AR/AP item by default; reuse source invoice open item
tax_provider_effect: Persist provider request/reference; NTS reference; callbacks; cancellation and reconciliation states; server-only credential
required_gate_conditions: Authenticated company; provider capability READY; approved immutable request; callback authenticity/replay checks; source/journal duplicate check; tax-period policy; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Tax document/version; source invoice/version; provider request/callback refs; NTS ref; reconciliation result; optional posting request
reversal_or_correction_rule: Provider cancellation does not mutate journal; follow approved tax amendment plus accounting reversal/correction policy
accountant_decisions_required: Whether tax document can be accounting source; taxable/zero/exempt/non-deductible mapping; VAT accounts; issue/amend/cancel timing; rounding; provider selection

posting_trigger: Approved cutover batch passes reconciliation and becomes POSTING_READY
example_debit_account_categories: Asset and expense opening accounts with debit balances; balancing account only per approved cutover design
example_credit_account_categories: Liability equity and revenue opening accounts with credit balances; balancing account only per approved cutover design
amount_basis: Accountant-approved trial balance at cutover date in base and transaction currency
subledger_effect: Create opening AR/AP items with partner and due-date detail that reconcile to control accounts
tax_provider_effect: No provider side effect; imported tax/provider references remain source metadata only
required_gate_conditions: Dedicated opening-balance capability; two-person approval; approved CoA version; first open period; reconciled trial balance; partner/project dimensions; zero net imbalance; READY source file; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Cutover batch/version; source file checksum/version; accountant approval ref; posting request; journal; opening open items
reversal_or_correction_rule: Never edit posted opening journal; approved correction uses reversal/adjustment according to cutover and period policy
accountant_decisions_required: Cutover date; opening clearing/retained earnings; comparative periods; AR/AP detail; FX rates; tax balances; reconciliation sign-off

posting_trigger: Authorized adjustment request receives required approval and becomes POSTING_READY
example_debit_account_categories: Policy-selected account categories based on documented adjustment
example_credit_account_categories: Policy-selected offset account categories based on documented adjustment
amount_basis: Approved amount; debit and credit must balance in base currency
subledger_effect: Create or modify open items only when the approved adjustment type explicitly requires it
tax_provider_effect: No provider effect unless separate approved reconciliation workflow links it
required_gate_conditions: FINANCE_POST plus adjustment capability; independent approval; mandatory reason/evidence; active accounts/rule; allowed period; required dimensions; balanced lines; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Adjustment request/version; approval snapshot; evidence versions; posting request; journal; affected source/open-item refs
reversal_or_correction_rule: Correction uses reversal and replacement adjustment; posted lines remain immutable
accountant_decisions_required: Allowed adjustment types; manual journal roles; materiality thresholds; account/dimension rules; tax effect; close-adjustment policy

posting_trigger: Authorized reversal request targets one posted unreversed journal
example_debit_account_categories: Original credit account categories become reversal debits
example_credit_account_categories: Original debit account categories become reversal credits
amount_basis: Exact original base amounts and line dimensions unless approved FX/current-period policy dictates explicit difference lines
subledger_effect: Reverse related open-item effects or create linked counter-items; allocation state corrected through audited workflow
tax_provider_effect: Provider cancellation is linked but does not by itself authorize accounting reversal
required_gate_conditions: FINANCE_REVERSE; original journal same company; reason; approval/step-up when required; allowed reversal period; no prior effective reversal; revision; idempotency
immutable_lineage: Original journal; reversal request/version; approval ref; reversal journal; source and provider cancellation refs
reversal_or_correction_rule: Creates a new linked journal with swapped debit/credit; original remains POSTED and immutable; corrected transaction posts separately
accountant_decisions_required: Reversal date; same-period vs current-period policy; FX/rounding differences; tax amendment dependency; approval/materiality thresholds
